summary: Mine Finders, Inc. submitted a comment opposing undue restrictions on mining exploration activities on public lands. Their position was part of a broader group of mining industry commenters who objected to ORV regulations being applied to mining vehicles, with the Department ultimately responding by excepting mining, oil, and gas geophysical exploration equipment from the off-road vehicle definition.
summary_quote: Mine Finders, Inc. - wanted to be able to explore without undue restrictions.
